test_title: PYST 26: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 20 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Provision for securing just and humane conditions of work and maternity relief comes under which Article of the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Article 42**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 42** of the **Indian Constitution** falls under the **Directive Principles of State Policy (Part IV).**
 
• It directs the State to make provisions for securing **just and humane conditions of work** and for **maternity relief**.
 
• It reflects the ideals of social justice and welfare, ensuring that workers are treated in a manner that upholds their dignity and ensures their well-being.
 
• This Article emphasizes that the State must work towards eliminating exploitation in workplaces and ensuring fair treatment for all workers.
 
• **Maternity relief** ensures the protection of women during pregnancy, granting them maternity leave, healthcare, and other benefits.
 
• Though the Directive Principles are not **legally enforceable**, they act as guidelines for the government to frame laws and policies.
 
• Examples of laws derived from this principle include the **Maternity Benefit Act, 1961**, which provides paid maternity leave and other benefits for women in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Article 39A**__

 __
 
• **Article 39A** directs the State to promote **equal justice** and provide **free legal aid** to ensure that opportunities for securing justice are not denied to any citizen by reason of economic or other disabilities.
 
• This Article emphasizes the importance of ensuring access to justice for all, irrespective of financial status.
 
 
 
• **Article 45**__
 __
 
• **Article 45** initially directed the State to provide **free and compulsory education to children** up to the age of 14 years.
 
• After the **86th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2002**, this provision was shifted to Part III as a fundamental right under **Article 21A**.
 
 
 
• **Article 47**__
 
 
• **Article 47** directs the State to regard the **raising of the level of nutrition** and the standard of living of its people and the improvement of public health as among its primary duties.
 
• It also includes the prohibition of the consumption of intoxicating drinks and drugs that are injurious to health.
